context.validated_for: uncached long-context retrieval (sustained visible-output gate not consistently met)

caveats: Retrieval passed twice at ~115K prompt tokens on the dual-card f16 KV route, but only one of two sustained repeats produced the required client-visible output; the strict gate did not pass. Capable/experimental, not recommended.
Measured with the seed cards' core/SM clock locked at 2300 MHz; throughput is specific to that operating point.
131K is the highest tier tested here, not a maximum-context claim.
The single-card IQ3_XXS 64K q8 route is the recommended Qwen3.8 preset.
